Validate one vertical before scaling the next

hero.headline: Agentic marketing — paper first, Ads only when signed.
hero.subhead: Strategy → Social → Ads. Until creatives, mix, and budget have an explicit GO: paper only (no pixel, no spend).

who.title: For whom
items: Retailer / ecom with clear offer and SKUs
Wants demand from social as a system
Brand voice owned by client’s ops/marketing (NEXUS does not invent ICP or offer)

how.title: How it works
items: 1) Brief + content pillars (one problem, one object)
2) Weekly paper batch: message · organic post · product story
3) Voice approval by client’s brand owner
5) Ads parked until photos + mix + budget signed

outcomes.title: Outcomes
items: Repeatable content system without invented claims
Paper ready for review before spend
Clear separation: NEXUS ≠ outbound (GTM OS) ≠ store Admin (Store OS)

notWhat.title: What it’s not
items: Live Ads / pixel / spend without GO
Owner of the client’s ICP or offer
